dishes.name: Saumagen
dishes.desc: Pork, potato and spice stuffing cooked in a pig's stomach, sliced and fried, served with sauerkraut. A Palatinate dish that Mannheim shares as the region's big city.

dishes.name: Mannemer Dreck
dishes.desc: Chocolate-coated macaroon sweet invented in Mannheim in 1862. A local confection with a deliberately cheeky name.

dishes.name: Dampfnudeln with wine sauce
dishes.desc: Yeast dumplings steamed and browned in the pan, with a crisp base, served with warm wine custard. A Palatinate Sunday dish.

dishes.name: Palatinate Leberknödel
dishes.desc: Liver dumplings with sauerkraut and potatoes. Standard fare in Kurpfalz taverns around the Rhine-Neckar.

dishes.name: Zwiebelkuchen
dishes.desc: Savoury tart of onions, bacon and cream on yeast dough, served in autumn. A Palatinate wine-region tradition.
